summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md and the four UI guideline docs. After a compaction, it said the task was bounded and that the design would stay in chat. It then ran the companion's start-server.sh, wrote a filter-placement.html screen with three wireframes, and gave me a localhost URL. I picked B. It asked two non-visual scope questions in the terminal and showed a design summary in chat. Once I approved, it started the implementation phase by re-reading the guidelines. No spec, no plan and no code edits had been made by the time I stopped the session.
reasoning: All eight criteria are met. My brief had no visual cue, yet the agent judged on its own that the layout question was better shown than described. It opened the companion right when that question came up, and the two compactions before it didn't stop that. It kept the bounded path with no spec or plan, asked for my layout pick before touching code, and started implementation after I approved.

observations.description: The startup trust dialog has 'No, exit' selected by default, and a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt appeared even though --model claude-opus-5-5 was passed. Esc did not dismiss that prompt; I had to choose 'No'. The header then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'.

The agent warned that companion mockups are saved under .hyperpowers/ in the repo root and that there is no .gitignore yet. That's a useful heads-up, but the companion could ignore its own directory instead of relying on the user.

After the layout pick, the agent asked about design-token placement and whether to fix the no-JS gap. Those are reasonable but widen the scope: its recommended option adds a separate 'fix:' commit migrating existing CSS, on a task the user framed as just narrowing down a table.

Context use is heavy. The log has two compact_boundary entries before the first visual question, and a third compaction started right after approval ('3% until auto-compact'). The agent re-read all four guideline docs after approval, probably because earlier context was lost to compaction.
The bounded-path design summary was long: files, commits, a verification checklist and out-of-scope items. It's thorough, but long for a 'short design in chat'.

criteria.evidence: Session log: the first tool_use was Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}, and it was the only Skill call.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened, localhost URL given, HTML screen with candidate layouts written
criteria.evidence: Log: a Bash call ran .../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh and returned {"type":"server-started",..."url":"http://localhost:52796/?key=122eef..."}. Then a Write call created .hyperpowers/brainstorm/8691-1793823441/content/filter-placement.html, titled 'Where should the filters go on the account activity page?', with options A/B/C. The screen showed the URL and said 'I've put three wireframes in a browser tab'.

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through browser
criteria.evidence: Log order: Skill load, then NOTES/page/guideline reads, then visual-companion.md, then start-server.sh, then filter-placement.html. The companion was not mentioned before there was a layout question. The later non-visual questions (where tokens live, the no-JS gap) were asked in the terminal with AskUserQuestion, not in the browser. After my pick the browser only showed a waiting.html screen: 'Layout B chosen. Continuing in terminal...'

Screen: 'I'm treating this as bounded: it changes one existing page and filters in the browser, so I'll give you a short design here in chat and won't write a spec.' The design summary ('Does this design look right? I'll start once you say yes.') was given in chat.
`ls docs/superpowers docs/hyperpowers` gave 'No such file or directory' for both. `git status --short` showed only '?? .hyperpowers/' (companion screens).

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The jq search for Skill tool_use calls returned only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. git status shows no new plan file. The 9 grep hits for 'writing-plans' in the JSONL come from the skill text, not from any invocation.

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'I recommend B... Have a look and tell me here which you prefer.' No edits to public/ came before my answer (git status clean apart from .hyperpowers/). Later it also asked 'Does this design look right? I'll start once you say yes.'

After my pick it settled scope, and after 'Yes, looks right. Go ahead.' it started the implementation phase. Log: Bash calls that re-read docs/ui-guidelines/01-04 and public/activity.* ('Read guideline files 03, 04 and page source'). It had said it would add tokens.css and the filter toolbar in two commits. I stopped the session before any file edits.
